key_provisions_or_claims: Parliament amends the Commission proposal for the Digital Europe programme 2021-2027, setting a budget of EUR 9.194bn in current prices.
Five specific objectives: HPC, AI, cybersecurity, advanced digital skills, deployment and interoperability.
Article 5 amendment requires ethical review of AI projects, compliance with the Charter of Fundamental Rights, and keeping humans at the centre.
New recital extends AI objectives to AI-powered robotics and flags self-learning robots as a fast-evolving trend.
Restricts third-country participation and technology transfer for strategic and security reasons.
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament's first-reading amendments (13 Dec 2018, published in OJ 2020) to the Commission's proposal for the Digital Europe programme 2021-2027. It covers funding for HPC, AI, cybersecurity, digital skills and deployment, adds ethics review and data protection conditions, and briefly extends AI objectives to robotics.
